definition: A non-coding small nuclear RNA molecule that is incorporated into the U2 small nuclear ribonucleoprotein (U2 snRNP) complex as an essential component of the major spliceosome, where it mediates pre-mRNA splicing by recognizing the intronic branch site via base pairing. Pathogenic variants in genes encoding U2 snRNA, such as RNU2-2, disrupt splicing and cause severe neurodevelopmental disorders, specifically developmental and epileptic encephalopathies.

source.title: Phenotypic and transcriptomic characterization of biallelic RNU2‐2 developmental and epileptic encephalopathy
source.quote: RNU2- 2 encodes a U2 snRNA variant that is incorporated into the major spliceosome as part of the U2 snRNP and represents a central component of the major spliceosome.
